init.title: Phrase hints
init.description: Phrase hints bias speech recognition toward your home's names. They are sent to Azure with each recording and use Azure's Fast Transcription API; if it fails, plain recognition without hints is used.

data_description.custom_phrases: One phrase per line, for words that are often misrecognised.
